authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI artifacts primarily affecting the zebras. The legs of the middle and right zebras show structural collapse, merging into each other and the sand without clear hoof definition (melting effect). Stripe patterns warp unnaturally near the neck/shoulder junctions. The dog's front paws appear slightly flattened and oversized with warped toe definitions. Despite these defects, the penguins are rendered with high fidelity, showing correct King Penguin morphology (orange patches, bill color) and clean edges. The lighting and beach environment are coherent, but the anatomical failures in the equines prevent a high authenticity score.

Structural Collapse: Zebra legs merge/melt into background and each other
Anatomical Error: Dog lacks German Shepherd erect ears and sloping topline
Texture Artifact: Zebra stripes warp irregularly at neck/shoulder
